checks.limits: Body includes the front step; studs, handle and terminal protection is supplied by the screw-fixed outer enclosure.

Selected 15-104 rings accept #8–10 studs, including Q0 terminal code 1 (#10-32). A #8-only ring is not acceptable. Crimp qualification remains a physical check.
Original adapter cable stays inside; extension, external coupling and feedthrough purchasing are removed.
Both complete component envelopes remain inside the case plan with a 10 mm screening margin.
checks.limits: Not a creepage/clearance standard or a restraint/thermal check.
